title: 第406章 她不得性病谁得？
slug: 离婚当天前夫小叔连夜抢我领证
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“别以为你们权势大就能用公安来吓唬我！谁知道是不是你儿子早就看上了我闺女，但他自己不行，所以才让我闺女去买药的？自己儿子不行怪谁？怪你们自己！”

田母的声音又尖又利，“你们也知道下了药，那他们发生关系也是真的！那孩子当然就是林秉轩的！”

林见微没有跟她吵，转过头，看向田小娥，“田小娥，我二哥真的碰了你吗？”

“难道你就不奇怪，为什么那天我二哥喝了水就没了意识？”

田小娥抬起头，愣愣地看着她，眼睛又红又肿。

“因为你妈拿错了药。”林见微一字一句地说：“她要的根本不是什么春药，是给牲口用的镇定剂。那东西能让一头成年母猪睡上半天，你想想，人喝了会怎么样？”

田小娥的眼睛一点点地瞪大了，她慢慢地转过头，看向自己的母亲。

难怪那天她喝了那杯水之后也晕了过去，醒来的时候林秉轩已经走了。

她什么都不记得，什么感觉都没有，甚至连床单上该有的痕迹都没有。

她以为是药效太强，以为是自己太紧张。

原来那根本就不是什么助兴的药。

才导致他们从头到尾都没成事。

田小娥的眼眶里的泪水不再流了，取而代之的是一种越来越浓的、近乎癫狂的绝望。

她猛地扑向田母，双手死死地抓着田母的衣领。

“妈！你害死我了！你害死我了！”

“要不是你拿错了药，我跟秉轩哥早就成了！我怎么还会去找那些人！我怎么会得这种病！妈——你害死我了啊——”

田母被女儿摇晃得东倒西歪，她抬手就是一巴掌，狠狠地扇在田小娥脸上。

“你在胡说什么！”

“害你的人是林秉轩！是他糟蹋了你又不认账！你还想不想过好日子了？”

田小娥捂着脸，不敢再说话了，只是低着头，肩膀一耸一耸地哭。

田母喘着粗气，梗着脖子，咬着牙，无论如何都不松口。

一口咬定田小娥肚子里的孩子就是林秉轩的。

说来说去就那几句话，“他们睡过”“孩子就是他的”“你们想赖账”。

要是林家敢不认，她就去单位闹，去市委闹，去天安门广场闹，闹到所有人都知道林家是什么东西。

方安雅气得浑身发抖，一句话都说不出来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Don't think that you are so powerful that you can use the police to scare me! Who knows if your son has already fallen in love with my daughter, but he couldn't do it himself, so he asked my daughter to buy medicine? Who can blame your son for not being able to do it? Blame yourselves!"

Tian's mother's voice was sharp and sharp, "You also know that they were drugged, so it is true that they had a relationship! Of course the child is Lin Bingxuan's!"

Lin Jianwei didn't argue with her, turned his head and looked at Tian Xiao'e, "Tian Xiao'e, did my second brother really touch you?"

"Aren't you surprised why my second brother lost consciousness after drinking water that day?"

Tian Xiao'e raised her head and looked at her blankly, her eyes red and swollen.

"Because your mother got the wrong medicine." Lin Jianwei said word by word: "What she wanted was not an aphrodisiac at all, but a sedative for livestock. That stuff can make an adult sow sleep for half a day. Think about it, what will happen if a person drinks it?"

Tian Xiao'e's eyes widened little by little, and she slowly turned her head to look at her mother.

No wonder she fainted after drinking that glass of water that day, and when she woke up, Lin Bingxuan was gone.

She remembered nothing, felt nothing, not even the traces that should have been on the sheets.

She thought it was because the medicine was too strong and she thought she was too nervous.

It turned out that it was not a fun drug at all.

That's why they failed from beginning to end.

The tears in Tian Xiao'e's eyes no longer flowed, replaced by a growing despair that was almost crazy.

She rushed towards Tian Mu, grabbing Tian Mu's collar with both hands.

"Mom! You killed me! You killed me!"

"If you hadn't taken the wrong medicine, Brother Bingxuan and I would have become friends! Why would I go to those people! How could I get this disease! Mom - you killed me -"

Tian's mother was shaken by her daughter. She raised her hand and slapped Tian Xiao'e hard on the face.

"What nonsense are you talking about!"

"The person who harmed you was Lin Bingxuan! He ruined you and refused to admit it! Do you still want to live a good life?"

Tian Xiao'e covered her face and did not dare to speak anymore. She just lowered her head and cried with her shoulders shrugged.

Tian's mother gasped, scratched her neck, gritted her teeth, and wouldn't let go no matter what.

He insisted that the child in Tian Xiao'e's belly was Lin Bingxuan's.

Just a few words, "They slept together", "The child is his", "You want to default on the debt".

If the Lin family dared to deny it, she would go to her workplace, the municipal committee, and Tiananmen Square to make trouble until everyone knew who the Lin family was.

Fang Anya was so angry that she was shaking all over and couldn't say a word.
